reaction: Riders attacking a village and I dig a shelter. Sounds like a burrow sandbox, I am in.

error: file must be a PNG basename (letters, numbers, underscore, hyphen) (invalid request, not a driver failure)

reaction: Little stick people and a shaft. I want to dig a sideways room off the cellar. No drag in my driver so I will tap stone.
A tap did mark it. It told me riders can come through the entrance, so I will go deeper.
Nice, it gave me a different reason this time: nobody can reach it. Making a staircase down.
Little red pickaxe squares! Making it my own secret den shape.
Even though it repeated the same unreachable message, all my squares took. A stick person is at my wall with a pick. Watching.

I am digging a den for a village hiding from riders. I tap stone with chalk and stick people decide to dig it. Meryem broke through coughing dust which is cute. It answered differently when I chalked unreachable stone, which I liked. Now it wants a store for jars. Lots of journal text but the picture is clear. A day passed in twenty seconds, faster than I expected.
Store for jars, I guess that is under furnish?

input.name: store Mark open ground for grain jars.

reaction: Putting the jar store in the bit Meryem just opened.
Whoa, midday to night the next day in like three seconds?
My nook has jars now and the people went to bed in their houses. Rubble on the floor is a nice touch.
Ooh a lamp. The same journal lines about Tamar and Kian keep repeating though.

input.name: lamp Hang a lamp over open ground.

reaction: Lamp at the bottom of my dug bit next to the chalk.
Lamp is up. Let us see if they dig my L-room now.
They dug almost all of it! Rubble everywhere. I want a proper sleepy room off the end.
I like watching my scribbled shape turn into a real hole with rubble. The journal keeps saying the same four lines about Tamar and Kian, which I have stopped reading.
Ha, I accidentally chalked into the neighbours stone and Yusuf just stared at it. That is the best reply so far, it did not stop me, it judged me. I am leaving it to see if they actually dig it.
Jars still empty for days. Who is meant to carry the barley? Checking the people.
Oh, the point is beds underground. Nobody has a sleeping place. Clear.

input.name: beds Mark open ground for sleeping.

reaction: The people dots all filled in when I added beds, that is satisfying. Now a door to keep riders out.

input.name: door Use a passage one square wide, open on two opposite sides.

reaction: What happens if I ring the bell when there are no riders? Cheeky test.
False alarm bell. It admits no riders are in sight. I want to see if people grumble about the boy who cried wolf.
"They looked at the bell, then at you." I laughed. That is exactly the response I wanted for a prank. I feel a bit guilty now, they will not trust the bell as much probably.
They are digging under the neighbours ridge. Oops. Kind of want to see the neighbours find out.

Stone door got built and Meryem tested it. The jars have been empty for about six days though and the top message never changes, so I am starting to wonder if I am meant to do something about the harvest.
Requested layout check, not my own idea: switching to phone size.

On phone size the hill is a skinny strip and my warren is shoved into the right edge behind the zoom buttons, with a big blank area below the journal line. I would have to pan to find my den. Going back to laptop.
Looking at the jar nook. Why is nobody bringing barley?
Resize scrolled my view so my taps missed. The neighbour bit is dug and dark now.
The store just says it is empty. I knew that. I want to know why nobody fills it.

input.name: lamp Hang a lamp over open ground.

reaction: Everyone said I will do it to my fake bell and then did something else. Ha. Tamar has been harvesting barley for ten days. Where does it go?
I can invite Tamar to check the boundary or end optional work, but not ask anyone to carry the barley down, which is the thing the top banner keeps nagging me about. Bit stuck.
Oops, the X on Tamar only went back to the village list, which pauses time, so my wait did nothing.
REAL smoke. Oh no, I already cried wolf. Ringing it for real and hoping they believe me this time.
Switching to Slow because riders are coming and I want to actually see it, not miss it between my clicks. Meryem wants a drink first, typical.
The view slid away from my warren by itself, right when the raid is coming. Annoying.

Scouts came. EVERYONE was asleep in the open, even with my six beds and the bell ringing. Nobody went in. All of them said after I finish eating or praying I will do it. If it had been a real attack they would all be caught. I feel kind of responsible, was it my fake bell? It does not say.
The scout scare was tense and I want to fix it before they come back with more riders.
Four riders on horses standing over my shaft with a red ripple. Spooky. Checking my door.
Finally Meryem and Tamar are going below. The door is theirs to shut, not mine. I like that it explains who is nearby.
Everyone has an excuse: eat, pray, drink, asleep. Kian saying I am asleep made me laugh. I will dig a deeper hiding hole since I cannot make them move.
Beyond riders reach! That is the spot. Now water is dry too. Problems are stacking up.
Speech bubble I agree to do it from two people hiding in the room I dug under the neighbours. The cheeky room is the safe room. Love that.
Three ticks! Survived the scouts even though everyone was napping outside. Feels like I passed by luck. Water next, but there is no well tool.
How do I make a well? Checking the i.
Info is about chalk and doors. Nothing about wells or water, but the banner says I need a well. Invisible wall feeling.
The raid moment was the best bit, but now there are two nag banners, empty grain and dry water, and nothing in the tools seems to fix either. I am poking around rather than playing.
Tapping the round thing up top did nothing at all, not even a nobody has seen this message. Waiting to see if they dig my deep room.
Guess: if I dig really deep maybe there is water down there. Zooming out to make room.
Erdem family with a donkey! People heard there was room, because of my beds I guess. Need four more beds and I want a deep well shaft.

Yusuf: his father found water to the west far below the hard stone, damp stone first. A hint right when I started a well shaft! Not sure if it heard me or it was timed. Wrong direction though, I am going east.
Taking Yusufs advice, turning the shaft west under the fields.
Same nobody can reach that stone message five times in a row. Last time they still got marked, so I am guessing they did again. Identical replies make me unsure.
Phew, all the marks took. Two diggers at the bottom. Lamp time so they do not stop at the dark.

input.name: lamp Hang a lamp over open ground.

reaction: No spare lamp, the ring marks the place, someone may make one. Lamps are actual things, not magic. Nice.
Bekir, a new guy, baked a clay lamp and hung it where I marked. Small but it feels like the village answers me. The repeating journal lines are still wallpaper though.
Back to Steady, the danger has passed and Slow makes the digging crawl.

input.name: beds Mark open ground for sleeping.

reaction: Twelve sleeping places and six are beyond riders reach. All ten dots full. Proud of my little deep bunk room.
Nothing to do except wait for hard stone. The journal is the same eight lines shuffled. I am waiting, but for what, riders again?
Every time I make room more people turn up with a donkey. It is like a sandbox that keeps raising the bar. The grain tick came eventually without me doing anything.
Little bubble circles under the bottom tunnel. Damp stone like Yusuf said?
Loose stone, quick to dig but can fall. Uh oh, my west tunnel goes right through it. Do I risk it? I want the water, so yes, but I feel nervous.

input.name: lamp Hang a lamp over open ground.

reaction: Emine made the second lamp. I am mostly waiting now. Still want to know if my loose stone tunnel finds water or caves in, that is the only thing keeping me.
Three people still without beds. Going to put beds in the deep west tunnel.

input.name: beds Mark open ground for sleeping.

reaction: Beds at the far end of the deep tunnel.
Fifteen places, space for everyone. All the dots went black. That felt good, quick and clear. But now nothing is asking me for anything except the water I cannot get.

Ha, I make room and five more show up with a donkey because they heard there was room. Funny once, but I can see the loop now: more people, more beds, repeat. The journal keeps saying the same four lines. I would leave about now.

I am stopping here. Yusuf staring at my mark and my fake bell were the best bits, and the raid was tense. But now it is beds, more families, beds, and water I cannot reach, and the journal repeats itself. I might come back if I knew how to get water, not on my own otherwise.
